judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/afterModelResponseUsage.acceptance.test.ts`). It completely omitted the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, meaning the newly added tests will fail. Additionally, it missed updating `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and the hook parameter name (`totalUsage`) on `OrchestratorHooks`. While the test cases and spec edit align conceptually with the ticket's goals, the core code change was never made.
